# Reuters

> > Reuters is a global news and information provider delivering breaking news, market data, and multimedia content through platforms like Reuters Connect.

Reuters serves journalists, financial professionals, and consumers with trusted news coverage, editorial workflow tools, and customer support services. The organization provides technical documentation and support resources for its professional content delivery platforms.

## Key Topics

- Reuters Connect
- Editorial workflow platform
- Content delivery
- News distribution
- Market data
- Multimedia content
- Reuters MyService
- Customer support
- Technical documentation
- Professional news services
- Breaking news
- Financial information
- Journalism tools

## Platform Documentation

- [Reuters Connect](https://liaison.reuters.com/page/reuters-connect-tech-notes): Reuters Connect editorial workflow platform tech notes & content delivery

## Support & Customer Service

- [Reuters MyService Community](https://help.reuters.com): Reuters MyService customer support community portal (error state)
